candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The normalized equivalent sand-grain roughness ks/Ra is dimensionless because it is a ratio of two lengths (ks and Ra), so their units cancel out. The input parameters include lengths (Ra, kt, k_rms) and dimensionless statistical measures (Sk, Ku, ES, Po). The dimensionless parameters do not contribute to the dimensional formula. Therefore, the output is dimensionless.

variables.physical_definition: the first-order absolute moment of height fluctuations, a length scale representing average roughness height
the peak-to-valley height, a length scale representing the vertical distance between the highest and lowest points of the roughness profile
the root-mean-square height, a length scale representing the standard deviation of height fluctuations
the skewness of roughness height fluctuations, a dimensionless statistical measure of asymmetry of the height distribution
the kurtosis of roughness height fluctuations, a dimensionless statistical measure of the 'tailedness' of the height distribution
the effective streamwise slope of the roughness, a dimensionless measure of slope
the surface porosity, a dimensionless measure of void fraction on the surface
